positions.name: SprintDeliveryAccounting
positions.frame: how does the team account for a sprint's outcomes — what shipped, how it measured, and what drove it?
positions.why: All three expressions share a matter-of-fact, past-tense, informational register: they recount settled facts about Sprint 4 without hedging or performance. src-1 declares the deliverable, src-2 supplies the velocity metric as evidence, and src-3 attributes the outcome to a single causal factor. Together they form a retrospective accounting — the team reporting what happened, measured how, and why it worked — read through a shared stance of composed, communal pride.
